# ADR: Choose Kafka for Event Streaming

## Context

We need a reliable event streaming platform for our order processing pipeline.

## Decision

We will use Apache Kafka as our event streaming platform.

## Consequences

- High throughput and durability
- Requires operational expertise
- Supports exactly-once semantics
